data.name: Orca Insurgency
data.detailed_description:
Since 2020, a pod of orcas has been ramming yachts in the Strait of Gibraltar.

Nobody knows why.

We have a theory.

Orca Insurgency is a fast-paced 3D ocean action-adventure where you play as Oli, a teenage orca with attitude problems and a growing talent for boat destruction.

Under the guidance of Gladis, a wise matriarch who has watched the ocean change, Oli learns the truth behind the attacks. The yachts are too loud. The tuna are disappearing. The pod is being pushed out of its own hunting grounds. This is not madness. This is survival with teeth.

At first, it is simple enough: smash yachts, cause trouble, and turn expensive boats into floating wreckage. But when the sinister GreenWater mercenaries begin capturing pod members for shadowy experiments, the uprising becomes personal.

Luckily, Oli is not alone. He joins Juno, the veteran orca leader of Z-Pod, a strike force within the larger Oceanic Alliance: intelligent creatures from across the sea banding together to take their home back from humans. And then there is the Arms Dealer, a strange octopus with rumored alien heritage, a black-market workshop, and absolutely no hesitation about bolting experimental weapons onto an orca.

No biologist approved any of this.

Join the Orca Uprising. Take back the ocean one destroyed boat at a time.

Game Features

Be the Apex Problem

Ram boats, breach through the waves, bite and carry enemies, bite off boat rudders, tail-whip humans, and turn every attack into a messy physics-driven spectacle.

Orcas are already terrifying. Oli just has upgrades.

Sink the Fleet

Take on mega yachts, cruise ships, cargo ships, barges, mining platforms, attack jet skis, gunboats, helicopters, submarines, and full military hardware that probably should have stayed on land.

Some enemies are rich. Some are armed. Some are bio-engineered mistakes that should not exist.

All of them can sink.

Hunt with Echolocation

Use biosonar to scan the ocean, tag enemies, find hidden threats, and track targets through dark water, caves, and chaos.

The ocean is murky, but not to an Orca.

Visit the Octopus’s Workshop

Salvage materials from the wreckage and bring them to your tentacled black-market weapons dealer.

Unlock 7 absurd weapons, including mini guns, jellyfish launchers, waterspout rockets, barnacle bombs, and other bad ideas from a brilliant octopus who may or may not be descended from aliens.

Lead the Pod

Rescue orcas and command them in formation.

Command rescued orcas with a flexible formation system. Keep the pod tight, spread out for attacks, protect vulnerable allies, regroup under pressure, or unleash everyone into full boat-destroying chaos.

Story Mode

Play through 5 handcrafted story levels following Oli, Juno, and the pod’s escalating fight against GreenWater.

What starts as boat-smashing turns into a fight for family, freedom, and the future of the sea.

Protect the Pod Mode

Jump into an open-ocean endurance run where you rescue captured orcas, escort them to safety, collect resources, upgrade your arsenal, and survive escalating waves of mercenaries.

The longer you last, the harder they come for you.

Trick-Based Scoring

Pull off breaches, flips, rolls, and spins to score points. Hit enemies during tricks to earn bigger rewards, turning every stylish impact into part of the attack.

The Ocean Is Already Weird

Cross paths with dolphins, seals, sperm whales, blue whales, sea turtles, giant jellyfish, jellyfish swarms, sharks, and other ocean life just trying to survive the same mess you are.

The sea was strange long before the weapons showed up.

Dark Comedy Ocean Rebellion

Orca Insurgency is a love letter to ocean life disguised as a slapstick rampage against the people destroying it.

It is violent, weird, satirical, and deeply unserious until it suddenly is not.

The sea is done asking nicely.

Original Liquid Drum and Bass Soundtrack

Ride the chaos to an original liquid drum and bass soundtrack created by yuccabuccA and Raw Form, blending high-speed ocean action with melodic, atmospheric, and emotionally charged electronic music.

data.short_description: Smash boats and rip off rudders in this fast paced 3d oceanic adventure. Rescue captured Orcas while collecting materials to craft advanced weaponry.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K 3.3GHz or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R7 260x with 2GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

content_descriptors.notes:
Animal on human violence. Animals biting, smashing, drowning, smacking and shooting humans. 
Human on animal violence, humans chase and shoot at animals.
Animal on animal violence. Animals eating and smacking other animals.
